subject.title: fix(cron): cap trigger script tool access

question: How should OpenClaw handle pre-existing trigger-script jobs that lack toolsAllow because their creator's historical tool policy was never persisted?
rationale: The patch cannot infer a trustworthy cap for legacy rows, while silently preserving them leaves the reported escalation path open and failing closed can break existing automation.

options.title: Audit legacy jobs
options.body: Merge the forward fix with a doctor or startup audit that lists uncapped legacy triggers and gives operators an explicit remediation path.

options.title: Fail closed
options.body: Block legacy trigger evaluation until an operator assigns a cap, accepting immediate compatibility impact for existing jobs.

options.title: Accept forward-only coverage
options.body: Merge without legacy auditing and explicitly accept that existing uncapped triggers remain unrestricted until edited.

recommendation.title: Audit legacy jobs
recommendation.body: Merge the forward fix with a doctor or startup audit that lists uncapped legacy triggers and gives operators an explicit remediation path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties steipete most directly to the cron SQLite and gateway trigger boundary where the upgrade policy belongs.
